items.t: Said the Biden administration's Title IX rule was administrative overreach and that he was glad to stop it.
items.q: The Title IX rule was the height of overreach, administrative overreach by the Biden administration , and we were very happy to be able to stop that," Skrmetti said on Tuesday.

items.t: Said the design decisions that made Instagram dangerous for kids are being addressed in the Meta settlement.
items.q: The most important thing is that all of the design decisions that made Instagram dangerous for kids are being addressed," Skrmetti said.

items.t: Said the goal is to eliminate the triggers for mental health problems built into the platform.
items.q: The goal is to eliminate all of the triggers for mental health problems that were baked into the platform as a result of the effort to make it so addictive," Skrmetti said.

items.t: Said the changes to Meta's platforms are ultimately more important than the financial penalty.
items.q: Skrmetti said the changes to Meta’s platforms are ultimately more important than the financial penalty.

items.t: Said the Meta settlement sets a precedent for holding social media, artificial intelligence and other child-facing platforms accountable.
items.q: I think you’re going to see the next domino fall very soon," Skrmetti said, arguing the agreement sets a precedent for holding social media, artificial intelligence and other child-facing platforms accountable.

items.t: Said the auditor under the Meta settlement could make public whether features still leave young users at risk.
items.q: If kids are still at risk, if some of these features aren't addressed in a way that meaningfully changes the danger of the platform for young users, the auditor will be in a position to make that public," Skrmetti said.

items.t: Said the discussion of suicide-rate data among minors was one of the most significant moments of the oral arguments in United States v. Skrmetti.
